messages:
Sofia: Heads up — I'm pulling together the quarterly alliance review deck and we need decisions on the funding framework for partners, SI enablement credits, and how marketplace onboarding credits should be structured. Can folks sync tomorrow? cc @Marcus @Priya

Marcus: Tomorrow 11am PT works for me. Proposed agenda: 1) funding bands + caps 2) scorecard recalibration for alliance metrics 3) marketplace credit plumbing 4) hardware co-funding terms. Want a pre-read?

Priya: Please add a section on thresholds for tier demotion and inactivity. Last cycle we saw partners keep credits unspent. For MDF, I propose ~10% carve to a small SI enablement pilot.

Kenji: From eng-ml: we need to clarify what "SI enablement" actually buys — training seats, dev hours, or compute credits. My suggestion: combine compute credits + 2 enablement sessions as the default bundle.

Alyssa: Finance can greenlight a 10% pilot reallocation but we need a simple burn model and recovery terms (how we claw back unused credits or reallocate). Can someone draft a 1-pager with numbers?

Sofia: I'll do the 1-pager and a quick model. Quick question for the group: when we say "marketplace onboarding credit" do we mean per-partner credits or per-customer credits applied by the partner? Need a decision.

Marcus: For SI programs, prefer per-partner credits (covers initial enablement). For marketplace vendors, prefer per-customer credits to incent customer conversions.

Priya: Also recommend we replace the vague metric "number of joint announcements" with something measurable like "active integrations shipped (customer-facing)" — that better captures enablement outcomes.

Kenji: +1. Also suggest adding "latency SLA compliance" for hardware partners as a quality metric; we had one HW partner rollout with perf regressions last quarter.

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent: "Alliance ops sync" tomorrow 2024-05-03 11:00 PT — link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/alliancesync (accept/decline here).

Alyssa: Quick cost table for discussion: per-partner onboarding bundle = 50k credits + 8 dev hours -> estimated equivalent spend $18k. We'll add a cap per tier to prevent runaway consumption.

Sofia: Thanks — I'll add that table to the pre-read and upload to Drive. Pre-read ETA: EOD today. If anyone has historical burn rates or examples of partner credit redemption profiles, please DM them to me.

Marcus: Dropping a tiny snapshot from last quarter for context:
```
Tiers: Gold (42 partners), Silver (118), Bronze (305)
MDF spend: $1.24M
Average partner redemption rate: 37%
Estimated ROI (co-sell influenced revenue): ~2.4x
```

Priya: Noted. Strong recommendation: set hard caps per partner by tier and a 6-month expiry on credits unless validated by activity. Also add a sunset clause for stale credits.

Kenji: I'll write a short note on compute gating: credits expire after 6 months unless the SI submits an integration validation (customer or staging test) — that will reduce hoarding.

Sofia: One last operational item — co-announcements process. Who owns PR review and launch windows? @Alyssa?

Alyssa: Marketing will own PR and asks a 2-week lead time for co-announcements. We'll create a simple review checklist and a shared doc for approvals.

Sofia: Awesome. I'll circulate the pre-read + invite the cross-functional reviewers. See you all tomorrow. :sparkles:
